info.title: MBW.Tools.GhStandardContent
info.description: .NET global tool to standardize content in Github repositories

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Standardize content across GitHub repositories and local worktrees.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format: text or json. [default: Text]

options.name: --color
options.description: Color mode: auto, always, or never. [default: Auto]

options.name: --verbosity
options.description: Output detail: quiet, normal, or detailed. [default: Normal]

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Validate configuration and source files without repository access.

arguments.name: CONFIG
arguments.description: Path to the repository configuration JSON/JSONC file. Environment: GHSC_CONFIG. [default: ]

commands.name: check
commands.description: Read repositories and report pending changes without writing.

options.name: --repository
options.description: Repository owner/name or an unambiguous short name. Repeat to select multiple repositories. Environment: GHSC_REPOSITORIES (semicolon-separated). [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --local
options.description: Operate on a local Git worktree instead of GitHub. Environment: GHSC_LOCAL.

options.name: --github-api
options.description: GitHub or GitHub Enterprise API base URI. Environment: GHSC_GITHUB_API. [default: https://api.github.com/]

options.name: --proxy
options.description: HTTP proxy URI. Environment: GHSC_PROXY.

options.name: --parallelism
options.description: Maximum repositories processed concurrently (1-16). Environment: GHSC_PARALLELISM. [default: 4]

options.name: --branch
options.description: Dedicated update branch name. Environment: GHSC_BRANCH. [default: feature/auto-contents]

options.name: --commit-author
options.description: Commit author name. Environment: GHSC_COMMIT_AUTHOR. [default: Auto Contents]

options.name: --commit-email
options.description: Commit author email. Environment: GHSC_COMMIT_EMAIL. [default: AutoContents@example.org]

options.name: --label
options.description: Pull-request label. Repeat for multiple labels. Environment: GHSC_LABELS (semicolon-separated). [default: System.String[]]

options.name: --meta-reference
options.description: Reference stored in metadata. Pass an empty value to remove the existing reference. Environment: GHSC_META_REFERENCE.

options.name: --orphaned-files
options.description: Handling for files that are no longer managed: error, keep, or delete. Environment: GHSC_ORPHANED_FILES. [default: Error]

arguments.name: CONFIG
arguments.description: Path to the repository configuration JSON/JSONC file. Environment: GHSC_CONFIG. [default: ]
